findings.a: Two of the four in-scope events are attributed to Ridgeline Chemical; both are at Millbrook.

blocks.q: Where do the in-scope events cluster?
blocks.a: {n_region_upper_basin} of {n_scope} in-scope events are in the Upper Basin.

viz.title: In-scope events by basin
viz.caption: One bar is one basin. The length is the number of in-scope events. Grade shows the lowest grade of any event counted. Click a bar to open the events.

care: Four events is far too few to show a pattern. This block exists to show the layout.
blocks.detail: The Regional Water Authority reported that discharge from the Millbrook outfall exceeded the permitted limit in February 2025.{{c:r2-permit-001}} The Valley Courier reported the release of March 2024.{{c:r1-upper-basin-001}}
